title: Back to Great Bamboo Peak's family
summary: The villagers cheer Zhang Xiaofan, Shi Tou and Bi Yao for ending the fox trouble, and Bi Yao warns them to stay away from the Black Stone Cave. Xiaofan asks the fortune teller whether demons have feelings, and the old man says there are good demons and bad people. At the Haiyun Building inn in Changhe, Bi Yao tells Xiaofan she half wishes they had died in the Dixue Cave and asks whether the line between the Demon Sect and the righteous matters so much to him. He cannot answer, and she leaves in the night with You Ji, having paid his bill. Shi Tou is called home to the Jingang Sect. Flying alone over the sea to Liubo Mountain, Xiaofan is attacked by Nian Laoda, Ye Gou Daoren and the Blood-Refining Hall. Tian Ling'er, Song Daren and Du Bishu come to help, and Tian Buyi's arrival drives the demons off. Xiaofan is welcomed back by Su Ru and Lin Jingyu, then learns that Tian Ling'er and Qi Hao are engaged.
